video_title: Vince Carter & Tracy McGrady Debate Whether Winning MVP Means More Than An NBA Championship

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Tracy McGrady and Vince Carter debate MVP versus NBA championship value
quotes.excerpt: the MVP of the regular season has more weight than a championship

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: The MVP of the regular season has more weight than a championship. Hell yeah, why wouldn't it?

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: Because everybody at the end of the day, you think about this, when we talk about the totality of a player's career, and even when you talk about Hall of Fame, and when you talk about the best players, the first thing they say is, 'Oh, but he didn't get a ring,' or 'He got a ring.' The 10th or the 11th player on the Chicago Bulls or the Los Angeles Lakers or the Detroit Pistons or the Boston Celtics, who are they? Name me any of those team, name me the 11th or the 12th guy.

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: You want me to? Just name one.

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: All right, you can't even think of them. He got a ring. You can't even think of them.

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: He has a ring. But does he have an MVP? Can he get an MVP? Absolutely not. No. So yes, the MVP of the regular season has more weight than a championship because it's the whole team. This is not just team, but it's ownership, it's management, it's health. It's all this shit that plays into winning a championship.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: Vince Carter argues ring culture overshadows individual player accomplishments
quotes.excerpt: we're putting too much emphasis on that instead of the body of work of what a player has done
quotes.quote: I think ring culture and everything that's involved with it has gone too far. We're putting too much emphasis on that instead of the body of work of what a player has done. It's easy to compare a guy, and that's a natural thing. So I'm not saying we should not, but you'll compare a player like, 'Oh, he has three championships, but he has five.' Because I think we go at that with the LeBron-MJ thing. It's situational.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: Vince Carter includes Kobe Bryant in the greatest of all time conversation
quotes.excerpt: I still think Kobe should be in that conversation
quotes.quote: We talk about the GOAT conversation, the greatest of all time. And obviously right now, we hear MJ, LeBron. I still think Kobe should be in that conversation. I don't understand. But we throw him, I don't think none of them goats. We talk about, we say MJ, just the outright goat. I just think they all great. They're all great. Kobe, you great. Charles Barkley great. Patrick Ewing great. I think we all are great, but it's situational.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Tracy McGrady explains how situational success defined championship winners
quotes.excerpt: you can't tell me if you was on the Spurs in early 2000s, on the Lakers
quotes.quote: You can't tell me if you was on the Spurs in early 2000s, on the Lakers, because that's who always winning the freaking championships then. It's situational. It's nothing to take away from the guys that actually have done it, right? It's nothing that they were in that situation. But I want to put this on record, you do wish you won a championship.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Tracy McGrady reflects on his time with the Minnesota Timberwolves
quotes.excerpt: Look how great KG was in Minnesota
quotes.quote: Look how great KG was in Minnesota. Unbelievable, much CTV, but didn't have an organization that put the pieces around him for the years that he was there. Trying to tell me that KG that wasn't great? What? And then he wasn't the same KG that was in Boston. What we played against in early 2000s, that was a different beast in Minnesota. That wasn't the same guy. Still effective and impactful, he's a motherfucker, right? But put that KG, put that KG Minnesota played the small forward. Come on, bro. Come on, bro. It's situational.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Tracy McGrady asserts that great players maintain intensity regardless of regular season timing
quotes.excerpt: competitors always are putting everything into it
quotes.quote: The whole ring thing, I get we're not in that conversation because we wasn't in those situations, right? But you're not going to sit here and tell me that if we were in that situation, we couldn't win a championship. Like these dudes is that much greater than us, and we play these dudes every night. We play them every night. And don't tell me, 'Oh, this is the regular season.' Nah, nah. Because you can't pick and choose when you feel somebody has better, who's better, or like, 'Oh, this the regular season, he ain't putting that much into it into the playoffs.' Nah, nah. Competitors always are putting everything into it. Just because this is a Wednesday night in December, that just don't mean anything? Nah, this means a lot.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: Vince Carter and Tracy McGrady agree regular season MVP holds more weight
quotes.excerpt: Regular season. All day. Over Finals MVP

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: So the last one, as you said that, I thought about this. Regular season MVP, Finals MVP?

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: Regular season. All day. Over Finals MVP.

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: Bro, you could be, Finals can go four games. You could be, you had a best four games of your your freaking career, your life, and you could luck up and have a great four to five games depending on how this team is defending your star players.

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: I don't want to use the word luck up.

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: I'm just saying, if your two, if your best player is receiving so much attention that where he has to defer. Absolutely. And you, you take advantage of the opportunity. Yeah.

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: You could luck up and get MVP.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: Vince Carter discusses how winning MVP changed the perception of Stephen Curry
quotes.excerpt: until he won that MVP, everybody kind of dangled that over his head
quotes.quote: It's crazy, I want to tie this into Steph Curry for a second, because it's funny how we viewed Steph as one of the greatest, and until he won that MVP, everybody kind of dangled that over his head.
